scene: You step into the lantern-lit Undercity Market.
picture: Along a tiled platform, the opened silver subway train stands at the far left. The player in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands facing forward left of centre. A steaming noodle cart sits on the left, a lizard merchant spreads gears on the centre ground, and an iron ladder rises on the right.
shown: a steaming noodle cart with hanging paper lanterns on the left
a lizard merchant sitting behind a rug of shiny gears, centre
a rusty metal ladder bolted against a brick pillar on the right
